description: Screenshot of a draft's overview page in the OpenCTI platform. A summary panel at the top shows fields Name, Status, Operations Completed, Total Number Of Operations, Work Start Time, Work End Time and a Progress bar. The 'Status' field (value 'Complete', shown as a green pill) is circled in red; that field actually reports the state of the draft's validation run, not the draft's workflow status, which is what the 'Status' caption elsewhere in the platform means.
